Internship Experience
Name: Rushabh Gala
Company: Tracelink
Role: Software Engineering Intern
About the Company: Tracelink is a USA based company which manages
pharmaceutical supply chains. Every medicine has a unique number which
is generated on the basis of some rules and there are a lot of strict
regulations
related
to
handling
medicines.
After
the
medicines
are
manufactured and number is given they travel from manufacturer to
different warehouses and different countries where it further goes to
wholesalers and finally to customers. In this process it is necessary to track
and trace each medicine as some of them can expire/get damaged/spoilt
etc. So Tracelink helps managing its clients’ supply chains by maintaining
the registry of whole process and creating serial numbers and helping in
the tracking and tracing. Also there are a set of rules to be followed which
vary from country to country so Tracelink also helps in abiding the rules and
regulations. Apart from these major functions tracelink also helps to
connect manufacturers to distributors and wholesalers so that all the
medicines are tracked and necessary medicines can be sent to places
where they are needed.
Interview Process: The interview process was as follows:
1. Online Test - Google form with MCQs and coding questions where
psuedocode was asked to be written.
2. Shortlisted
students
were
called
at
their
office
for
interviews.
Interviews were of 3 rounds with 2 Technical and 1 HR round.
Questions asked:
Round 1: Technical questions were asked and logic based questions were
asked to solve on paper with pseudocode. This round went on for around
20 minutes.
Round 2: Technical + Resume based questions were asked. In Technical 1
simple logic based question and a little about OOPs and some about Java.
Resume
based
questions
went
on
longer
because
a
lot
of cross

questioning was done. Some HR questions were also asked. The round
went on for about 30-40 minutes.
Round 3: Only a few students were selected for round 3. It was for 10-15
minutes and the HR asked some general questions based on resume as
well as basic HR questions.
Preparation Strategy: I had read the previous year’s experience and
found out that they use Java so I prepared Java interview questions from
different websites like GFG, Javatpoint etc. For the 1st round of coding
questions I used to practice on LeetCode but can do it on other websites.
Data Structures knowledge is important as coding questions were on
Graph and in the interview also some theoretical questions were asked. I
also went through HR questions on various websites. I had a clear
understanding of my resume so I was able to answer the Resume based
questions.
Key Insights:
1. One key insight was that Tracelink wants students who will be with
them if given PPO. So if asked what are your plans after graduation
do not say that you are going to go for further studies. That would put
you at a disadvantage. Tell them that you are going to do a job after
graduation.
2. The internship was very good and I got to learn a lot as I was directly
put into the development team and my work has actually been used
in their software. I was not given a side project. As a company
Tracelink is very very good with friendly people, good environment,
no pressure or too much workload, adjustable timings and flexible
options(can take many days work from home).
3. There is a free pantry with free lunch also and snacks, cold drinks.
Also games like carrom, foosball, Xbox are there. It is a fun and chill
environment to work in.
Acceptance and Next Steps: There is a final presentation but the decision
of PPO is taken before only by the manager assigned to you. The decision
is taken on the basis of work done so of course you have to do the work
assigned within the given time but it is a great company to work in.
